tips.text: Keep attacking enemy champions so Cultivation of Spirit fills fast, then cast it for extra Attack Speed and damage that spreads to nearby enemies.
Hit enemy champions rather than minions to build Unleash faster, since each attack on a champion counts for more.
Land your prayer bead on an enemy who steps up for a last-hit; it leaves them slowed and keeps hurting them while it lingers.
Use Kanmei's Steps to chase or escape; the speed boost is bigger when you move toward an enemy champion.
Save Transcend One's Self for a real fight or a kill chance; it upgrades all your basic abilities and refreshes your cooldowns.
While transcended, use Untouchable Shadow to dash in or out of fights, and fire Arc of Ruin for a long-range slow and big damage.
Fight when enemies are grouped up, since Cultivation of Spirit spreads each attack to every enemy near your target.
Keep away from Aphelios when he holds Gravitum. Its shots slow you, and he can then root you.
Land your prayer bead on Aphelios when he steps up to attack. The slow lets you trade and walk away.
Attack to build Unleash, and use Cultivation of Spirit when it is full for a burst of attack speed in a trade.
Use Kanmei's Steps to walk toward him for extra speed and close the gap, or to get away when his weapons are strong.
Dodge Enchanted Crystal Arrow by staying out of line with Ashe, and by keeping minions and allies between you in a long fight.
Throw your prayer bead at Ashe when she walks up; it slows her heavily and lets you trade or run in.
Ashe has few defensive options, so go all in with Transcend One's Self when she has used her Enchanted Crystal Arrow.
Use Kanmei's Steps to close on Ashe; the speed is higher while you move toward her.
Dodge Sear first. Brand needs it to land after other spells to stun you, so sidestep it and his combo falls apart.
Walk out of Pillar of Flame as soon as it appears; it lands after a delay. Move off the marked ground instead of standing still.
Slow Brand with your prayer bead when he steps up to cast. Poke him while he is slowed, since his spells are mostly aimed.
Keep distance from your support and minions when Pyroclasm is cast; its first missile is slow, so you can step away before it bounces.
Use Kanmei's Steps to walk away from or around his spells. Use Transcend One's Self to trade back once his key spells are on cooldown.
Stay out of Caitlyn's Piltover Peacemaker range and keep minions between you; the shot deals less to later targets.
Do not walk over unseen ground near Caitlyn; Yordle Snap Trap roots you and sets up a long-range Headshot.
Hit Caitlyn with your prayer bead when she is close or has used her net; the slow makes it hard for her to get away.
Use Transcend One's Self when you can reach Caitlyn; she is easier to catch while her net is on cooldown.
Use Kanmei's Steps to close distance toward Caitlyn once her net is spent.
Stay out of Cassiopeia's Noxious Blast by moving sideways. It lands after a short delay, so walking straight lets it hit.
Throw your prayer bead at Cassiopeia when she steps up to trade. The slow gives you time to back off.
Use Kanmei's Steps before Miasma lands. Once you are in the cloud you are grounded and can't use movement abilities.
Turn away from Cassiopeia as Petrifying Gaze goes off, so you are only slowed and not stunned.
Trade with Cassiopeia when she has no Twin Fang ready or just missed Noxious Blast. Her damage is far weaker without poison.
Stay out of Corki's Phosphorus Bomb range when you can; it reveals you in the brush and hurts to trade into.
Hit Corki with your prayer bead when he walks up to trade; being slowed stops him from kiting or running away.
Do not hide behind minions from Missile Barrage; it splashes and still hits you.
Use Kanmei's Steps to close in on Corki or step away from his Gatling Gun; it gives extra Move Speed when you run at an enemy.
Punish Corki right after he uses Valkyrie to enter a fight; he is vulnerable then, so slow him and focus him.
Build Unleash by attacking Corki, since champions give extra stacks, then use Cultivation of Spirit to win the trade.
Land your slowing prayer bead on Draven when he reaches for an axe; being slowed makes him miss the catch and cuts his damage.
Keep your distance from Draven's Stand Aside; if it hits you, you are knocked back and slowed, and he follows up.
Stay out of Draven's hands when you are low on health. Whirling Death can execute you from across the map.
Use Kanmei's Steps to walk toward Draven in a trade; you move faster when you head at him.
Trade with Transcend One's Self when Draven has just used Stand Aside. Untouchable Shadow then dashes you away or onto him.
Stay behind minions when Ezreal is in range, because Mystic Shot ends at the first enemy it hits.
Hit Ezreal with your prayer bead when he walks up; it leaves him slowed, and he is fragile, so punish him.
Attack Ezreal to build Unleash faster, since hits on champions give extra stacks, then use Cultivation of Spirit for a strong trade.
Wait until Arcane Shift is used before you go in; he has no other escape and it has a long cooldown early.
Once Transcend One's Self is on, dash toward Ezreal and finish him with the beam.
Stay out of a straight line with Hwei when his Devastating Fire could fly at you; sidestep it, since it stops on the first target it hits.
Throw your prayer bead to slow Hwei when he steps up, then walk in and attack him while he is slowed.
Walk toward Hwei with Kanmei's Steps to close in fast, then trade before his spells come back.
Hwei is open to a rush after he casts Gaze of the Abyss or Crushing Maw, so step in and attack once the spell is out.
Do not stand still when the lightning of Severing Bolt is coming; it hits harder on a target who is alone or cannot move, so keep moving.
Once your ultimate is active, save Untouchable Shadow to dash out of Hwei's Crushing Maw or his root.
Walk up and trade while Jhin is reloading, since he can't attack then. Use Cultivation of Spirit to build up your attacks.
Stay out of line with Deadly Flourish after you take damage. It roots you if you were hit recently.
Watch for invisible traps in bushes and lanes. Don't walk in blindly; save Kanmei's Steps to get out if you are caught.
Throw your prayer bead at Jhin when he walks up to hit you. He is slowed, so it is hard for him to retreat.
Keep your health up before level 6 on Jhin's side. His Curtain Call finishes weak targets, so don't run away at low health in a straight line.
Don't dash over ground where Jinx has thrown Flame Chompers! or you'll be rooted.
Jump on Jinx when she pokes with rockets, before her minigun ramps up.
Use Kanmei's Steps | Untouchable Shadow to close the gap when you are facing Jinx, but avoid her Zap! range if you can.
Use Arc of Judgment | Arc of Ruin to leave Jinx slowed, to chase her or stop her kiting you.
Build up Unleash by attacking Jinx so you can use Cultivation of Spirit for more attack speed when you trade.
Throw your prayer bead at Kai'Sa when she steps up to trade; the slow lets you hit her freely.
Stay out of Kai'Sa's Void Seeker range when you can; it adds Plasma that lets her jump on you with Killer Instinct.
Keep attacking in lane to fill Unleash, then use Cultivation of Spirit for a burst of attack speed in trades.
Use Transcend One's Self when Kai'Sa jumps in; Untouchable Shadow dashes you away from her.
Land your prayer bead on Kalista when she dashes in; the slow stops her from kiting and her attacks stall.
Kalista cannot cancel her attack windup, so cast your ability right as she starts an attack.
Step out of range when Kalista has many spears on you; Rend hurts more with each one.
Use Kanmei's Steps to dodge Pierce and close the gap when you want to trade.
Break line of sight with a brush or minions when Kalista attacks, since her attacks miss you.
Hit Karthus with Arc of Judgment | Arc of Ruin from long range; it leaves him slowed and he has no dash to escape.
Dodge Lay Waste by moving sideways with Kanmei's Steps | Untouchable Shadow after you see the blast land. It takes a moment to go off.
Stay near your minions so Lay Waste hits more than one target and deals less damage to you.
Step away from Karthus's corpse after you kill him; he can still cast spells for a few seconds.
Keep your health high late in the lane. Requiem hits you from anywhere, and a beam of light warns you when it starts.
Hit Kog'Maw with your prayer bead when he steps up to attack; the slow stops him from backing away.
Trade when his Bio-Arcane Barrage is down; his range is much shorter then.
Fight Kog'Maw after using Transcend One's Self; he has no escape and Untouchable Shadow lets you dash in to reach him.
Walk out of Void Ooze's trail rather than through it, and dodge Caustic Spittle by standing off the minion line.
Run away when Kog'Maw dies; Icathian Surprise explodes after a few seconds and deals true damage.
Hold Kanmei's Steps for when Lucian commits. Walking toward him gives extra Move Speed to close the gap and fight back.
Throw your prayer bead at Lucian when he dashes in. It slows him so he cannot escape, and the bead keeps hurting him.
Lucian has strong burst but little lasting damage. Step out of the line of Piercing Light, since it hits a set angle after a short wind-up.
Avoid the line of The Culling. He cannot turn it once he starts, so sidestep out of the bullets.
Attack champions to fill Unleash, then use Cultivation of Spirit for a fast, strong trade.
Stay out of a straight line with Lux and keep minions out of her path; Light Binding roots the first two enemies it hits.
Use Kanmei's Steps to sidestep Light Binding or to close in on Lux when her root is down.
Hit Lux with your prayer bead from long range; she is fragile and the slow stops her from lining up spells.
Move sideways when you see Final Spark's red warning line; leave the line fast.
Walk out of Lucent Singularity before it blows up; it slows you and then hits.
Hit Miss Fortune with your prayer bead when she steps up to last-hit. The slow stops her Strut speed from helping her.
Walk away from Double Up when you stand behind a minion. It bounces to whoever is behind its target.
Step out of Make It Rain quickly. It slows and hurts you for the whole time you stand inside it.
Use Cultivation of Spirit on her when it is ready. Your attacks spread to nearby enemies and you attack faster.
Trigger Transcend One's Self to reach her. The dash and beam make her easy to kill when she is hit.
Don't stand still in front of Bullet Time. Move out of the cone to avoid the full channel.
Hit Nilah with your prayer bead when she dashes in; she is slowed and has trouble reaching you or escaping.
Keep your distance and auto from range. Nilah has to dash in with Slipstream to reach you, so be ready to slow her as she arrives.
Do not waste your prayer bead while Jubilant Veil is up; save your slow for when her Veil ends, since your basic attacks are dodged.
Keep a safe distance when Nilah has Apotheosis ready; it pulls you toward her, so stay out of its range.
Use Kanmei's Steps to run away after she lands on you, since it gives bonus move speed.
Do not throw your prayer bead while Samira stands close with Blade Whirl ready; she can destroy it. Bait it out first.
Slow Samira with your prayer bead when she dashes in, then back away. Staying at range keeps her sword attacks from landing.
Keep distance from Samira in lane. Her Wild Rush closes the gap fast and can reset on a kill.
Trade with Cultivation of Spirit when it is ready; its spread hits and extra attack speed win short fights. Time it before Samira gets in.
Samira's Inferno Trigger needs a full Style rating. Back off when she has built it up by hitting you, then she wastes it.
Stay out of Last Embrace's line; it hits the first enemy and roots you shortly after, so keep a minion between you and Senna.
Throw your prayer bead at Senna when she walks up; she is slowed hard, which lets you trade or get away.
Senna outranges you early, so don't stand in her range for free pokes; trade only after she has used Piercing Darkness.
Use Kanmei's Steps to walk toward Senna in a fight or away from her, but save it to get out once Last Embrace has landed.
Fight with Cultivation of Spirit ready, then trade through Senna's slow; at level 6 Transcend One's Self makes you the stronger duelist.
Hold your prayer bead until Sivir's Spell Shield is used. Throwing it into the shield wastes it and heals her.
Sidestep Boomerang Blade. It costs her a lot of mana, and it comes back along the same path, so don't stand in it twice.
Hit Sivir with your prayer bead so she is slowed, then keep attacking to build Unleash for Cultivation of Spirit.
Do not trade into Sivir when Ricochet is up. Its attack speed and bounces hurt, especially if you stand near minions.
Do not leave Sivir's pushing alone for long. Use Transcend One's Self to trade hard with Arc of Ruin and Cultivation of Spirit.
Press Smolder early while he has few stacks of Dragon Practice; he is weakest before he has landed many abilities on champions.
Throw your prayer bead to leave Smolder slowed when he steps up to poke, then trade with your attacks while he can't leave.
Attack champions to build Unleash faster, then use Cultivation of Spirit for a short, fast-hitting trade.
Hit Smolder with Arc of Ruin when he flies with Flap, Flap, Flap; the slow cuts his escape short.
Keep your distance from his Super Scorcher Breath, which has short range. Use Kanmei's Steps to close in only when you can win the trade.
Throw your prayer bead at Tristana when she steps up to trade; it slows her and she can't easily get away.
Respect Tristana's longer reach early. Attack minions and wait until Cultivation of Spirit is ready before you walk up.
When Tristana puts Explosive Charge on you, step away from her and your minions before it goes off.
Stay out of Buster Shot range with Kanmei's Steps ready when Tristana has her ultimate; the stun can get you killed.
Use Transcend One's Self to win a trade: Arc of Ruin and the free Cultivation of Spirit make your all-in strong.
Shoot your prayer bead at Twitch when he walks up; the slow lets you hit him and keep your distance. He is fragile.
Do not stand in Venom Cask's cloud. It slows you and stacks Deadly Venom, which Contaminate then turns into big damage.
Use Kanmei's Steps to close in on Twitch or to leave his Venom Cask, since it gives extra speed toward enemy champions.
Cast Transcend One's Self when Twitch is caught close to you, then dash and fire Arc of Ruin before he can retreat.
Watch for Twitch going missing; he may be camouflaged after Ambush, so stay with your minions and avoid walking up alone.
Stay out of Piercing Arrow's long range. Move sideways when you see Varus charging it, since it is a straight line.
Use Kanmei's Steps to close in on Varus, since it gives more speed when you move toward an enemy champion. Then land your slowing bead on him.
Keep your distance from Varus when Chain of Corruption is ready. If you are rooted, run far enough from the tendril to stop it spreading.
Avoid fighting in his Hail of Arrows patch. It slows you and cuts your healing.
Trade by attacking Varus until your Cultivation of Spirit is ready, then use it to fight. Her bonus speed and spreading attacks win close fights.
Stay away from walls when Vayne is nearby. Condemn knocks you back and stuns you if you hit terrain.
Hit Vayne with your prayer bead from long range to slow her. She is fragile, so follow up while she is slowed.
Keep attacking Vayne to build Unleash faster, since attacks on champions give more. Then use Cultivation of Spirit to win the trade.
Vayne's third hit on you deals extra damage. Step back or move away before it lands, or you will lose more health.
Use Kanmei's Steps to move away from Vayne when she goes for you. It is faster when you move toward her.
Watch for Dark Matter's marker and sidestep it after it appears. Do not walk in a straight line when Veigar is in range.
Do not walk into the edge of Event Horizon's cage. Stay inside it or step around it, and you will not be stunned.
Hit Veigar with your prayer bead from long range. He is fragile and slowed targets struggle to escape.
Keep Kanmei's Steps ready to dodge Dark Matter or to leave when Event Horizon goes up.
Stay healthy against Veigar, since Primordial Burst deals more damage the lower you are. Back off when you are hurt.
Use Transcend One's Self to dash and fire at Veigar when he has used Event Horizon.
Keep auto attacking to build Unleash, and trade when Cultivation of Spirit is ready for faster attacks that hit nearby enemies.
Land your prayer bead on Xayah when she steps up to trade. It leaves her slowed, so you can hit her freely.
Stay off the Feathers Xayah leaves behind. Stepping on them lets Bladecaller root you.
Use Kanmei's Steps to slip out of Feather lines or to close in on Xayah.
Do not fire Arc of Ruin at Xayah while she is in Featherstorm. She cannot be targeted, so wait until she lands.
Start Transcend One's Self when Xayah has used her Feathers. Then fight her.
Throw your bead at Yasuo when he walks up to trade. The slow cuts his dash-in short.
Hold your bead while Wind Wall is up. It blocks projectiles, so wait for the wall to fade.
Use Kanmei's Steps to back away when Yasuo goes for you.
Stay away from minions he can dash through. Sweeping Blade needs a target, so he cannot close on you across an empty gap.
Keep hitting him to build Unleash so Cultivation of Spirit is ready before a fight.
Walk toward Zeri with Kanmei's Steps to close the distance. Your extra speed is larger when you move toward an enemy champion.
Land your prayer bead on Zeri, then keep attacking. The slow stops her from escaping while you hit her.
Fight Zeri after she has used Spark Surge. Its cooldown is long, so she has little to escape with.
Hit Zeri with attacks to fill up Unleash. Cultivation of Spirit then gives you attack speed for a strong trade.
Dodge Ultrashock Laser by stepping sideways. If it hits a wall, it turns into a laser that fires from there, so don't stand near walls.
Walk around Ziggs' mines instead of stepping on them. They slow you and make his other spells easier to land.
Hit Ziggs with your prayer bead when he walks up to poke. The slow makes it hard for him to get away.
Trade with Ziggs right after he uses his long-cooldown spells, since you can attack him freely.
Use Kanmei's Steps to dodge Bouncing Bomb and close the gap when he is out of spells.
Save Transcend One's Self for when Ziggs has used Satchel Charge, then rush him.
